summary.text: Adam Chitwood is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 173 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Darlene Taylor.
An accountant who was born in Muscatine, Iowa, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he moved to Thomasville through his career.

paragraphs.text: Adam Chitwood attended Muscatine High School and Scott Community College, and Ballotpedia lists degrees from Upper Iowa University and graduate study at the University of Iowa and Upper Iowa University.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in 1988 in Muscatine, Iowa, grew up in a family that relied on food stamps, and worked his way through college.
He said his career later brought him to Thomasville, in District 173, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as accountant.
Chitwood advanced from the Democratic primary for District 173 on May 19, 2026.
In the survey, he said he supports raising Georgia's minimum wage to $18 an hour by 2030, creating a state earned income tax credit and raising teacher pay by $6,000 over two years.
He also said he supports Medicaid expansion and a $200 million rural hospital fund.
